digest.component_or_area: CI workflow and tickets store initialization
propositions: Fresh full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB and 59s wall time; blob:none filter reduces this to 68.7 MiB and 14.3s, a 15x reduction
CI actions/checkout step for tickets takes 237s (92% of verify-identity job) versus 2s for manual worktree mount; blob:none filter can reduce this significantly

In Claude Code web environment, tickets fetch timeout causes rebar init to silently bootstrap an empty orphan store that diverges from origin/tickets, returning empty results and preventing fast-forward merges
blob:none partial clone preserves complete commit graph and enables merge-base queries needed for identity.enforce_since era scoping, unlike shallow clones which would break ancestry detection
derive_caused_by must fail closed when git blame fails on any path rather than tallying partial paths, which would write incorrect caused_by links
gerrit-verify.yaml verify-identity job requires full-history clone for merge-base scoping; this requirement is met by blob:none partial clone which preserves commit ancestry
